set_value.name: player.entity.$AdvancedTargetingHotkeysConfig
set_value.exact: table[ $groupCombatEnabled = true, $groupFleetEnabled = true, $groupNavigationEnabled = true, $groupResourcesEnabled = true, $groupSurfaceEnabled = true, $groupMissionEnabled = true, $rangeMultiplier = 2, $soundEnabled = true, $notifyOnFailure = true, $stickyModeEnabled = true, $dockableScanLimit = 12, $targetingBackend = 'lua', ]

set_value.name: player.entity.$AdvancedTargetingHotkeysState
set_value.exact: table[ $mode = null, $surfaceMode = null, $surfaceParent = null, $surfaceTarget = null, $selfChange = false, $shiftPending = false, $shiftTarget = null, ]

do_if.value: $autoShiftMode == 'enemyAll' or $autoShiftMode == 'enemySmall' or $autoShiftMode == 'enemyLarge' or $autoShiftMode == 'missiles' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceAll' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceEngines' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceTurrets' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceShields'

$candidate.isplayerowned or ($candidate.isradarvisible and $candidate.distanceto.{player.entity} le $radar) or ($candidate.iscapitalship and $candidate.distanceto.{player.entity} le $farRadar) or $candidate.isclass.station or $candidate.isclass.gate or $candidate.isclass.highwayentrygate

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: surface parent %s yielded %s candidates for mode %s'.[$parent.knownname, $candidates.count, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: no usable surface hull for mode %s, target %s'.[$mode, @player.target.knownname]

find_object.name: $found
find_object.class: [class.ship, class.station, class.highwayentrygate, class.gate, class.collectablewares, class.asteroid, class.missile, class.mine, class.explosive, class.lockbox, class.navbeacon, class.resourceprobe, class.satellite]

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: applying target %s, id %s, mode %s, backend %s'.[$thing.knownname, $thing.idcode, $mode, $config.$targetingBackend]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: nothing matched for mode %s, target left unchanged'.[$mode]

'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: registering actions, groups combat %s fleet %s navigation %s resources %s surface %s mission %s'.[ $config.$groupCombatEnabled, $config.$groupFleetEnabled, $config.$groupNavigationEnabled, $config.$groupResourcesEnabled, $config.$groupSurfaceEnabled, $config.$groupMissionEnabled]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: acquire id %s, mode %s'.[$id, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: cycle id %s, mode %s, %s candidates'.[$id, $mode, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: cycle stepped from index %s of %s'.[$index, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: deselect, clearing mode %s'.[$state.$mode]

find_object.name: $found
find_object.class: [class.ship, class.station, class.highwayentrygate, class.gate, class.collectablewares, class.asteroid, class.missile, class.mine, class.explosive, class.lockbox, class.navbeacon, class.resourceprobe, class.satellite]

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: line of sight pass %s at %s, found %s'.[$pass, $angle, $thing]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: target changed to %s, ours: %s, mode %s'.[event.param, $state.$selfChange, $state.$mode]

'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: changed detail - t %s, issurface %s, sTarget %s, sParent %s, sMode %s, age %s'.[event.param, @event.param.issurfaceelement, $state.$surfaceTarget, @$state.$surfaceParent.knownname, $state.$surfaceMode, player.age]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift pending, ignoring target change to %s, holding mode %s'.[event.param, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - surface element lost, was %s on hull %s, keeping mode %s'.[$state.$surfaceTarget, @$state.$surfaceParent.knownname, $state.$surfaceMode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - target cleared externally with no surface state, resetting mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - external surface pick, entering surface mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - external object pick, resetting mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: tracked target %s destroyed, killer %s, mode %s - queueing shift'.[event.object, event.param, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: dying target was index %s of %s, successor %s'.[$index, $candidates.count, @$state.$shiftTarget.knownname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: dying target not in mode %s list of %s, no successor recorded'.[$mode, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shifting to recorded successor %s'.[$queued.knownname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift not needed, target %s is already in mode %s'.[player.target, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: hull %s has no elements left, falling back to the hull itself'.[$state.$surfaceParent.knownname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shifting to %s, mode %s, %s candidates'.[$thing.knownname, $mode, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: nothing left to shift to for mode %s, leaving target alone'.[$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift skipped, mode %s does not auto-shift'.[$mode]
